title: 第17章 晋武侯第18章 惊讶的二皇女
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
军帐中！
夏辰打量着钱南，半晌没有说话，钱南当即额头上的冷汗便冒了出来。
就在钱南内心心惊胆战的时候，耳边传来一道平静的声音。
“起来吧！”
“谢大人！”
钱南心中一松，感觉笼罩自身的压迫消散不见，刚才只是短短的一瞬间，他便感觉度日如年。
他感觉这位新来的校尉，身上的威势，比军中的中郎将大人竟还要可怕许多。
“这就是镇东侯府出来的嫡系吗？这气度当真不一般！”
钱南在内心感叹。
“巡街如何？”
“一切安好，中途碰到一起偷盗事件，已经将小偷抓进刑部大牢了！”
钱南连忙恭敬回应。
夏辰又询问了一些问题，主要是关于羽林卫的工作范畴，以及一些注意事项，当然大部分他都已经知道，他询问的是一些细节。
“最近京城有些不太平，大庆的探子开始冒头，咱们羽林卫被命令协助提灯人要尽快将这些探子查找出来！”
钱南又提到一桩事情引起了夏辰的注意。
提灯人是一个组织名称，在大武朝情况特殊，不归属于内阁，也不隶属于六部，是一个独立于文官武官体系之外，只对皇帝负责的一个组织。
有点类似于夏辰记忆中明朝的锦衣卫。
夏辰若有所思的点了点头，没有再继续追问。
禁军虽然势大，但此时非战乱时期，其实禁军在京城中，威势并没有想象中的那么大。
至少，一旦出现一些案件或者敌国暗探，皇帝第一个想到的是提灯人，再其次是刑部，大理寺等，他们羽林卫大多都只是协助，或者是最后尘埃落定，帮忙上门抓人抄家等。

……
中午！
夏辰请同僚下属等去京城同福楼吃饭，诸位同僚都很给面子。
只要在军中且没有任务的，都来到了同福楼。
到最后，就连李文忠和秦木都到达了现场，这让夏辰的同僚皆是心中凛然，大家在京城混的，都是人精，太明白这一幕代表什么了。
因此对待夏辰愈发的恭敬，频频热情主动敬酒。
就在夏辰这边春风得意时，京城晋武侯府已经炸开了锅。
“少爷，少爷，这是怎么了！”
一座气派不凡的大门前，门卫大老远的就看到被家兵带回来的赵宇。
此时赵宇模样极为的凄惨，不仅双臂下垂，整个背部都已经血肉模糊，而他整个人早就已经昏迷了过去，不省人事。
赶过来的门卫看到这一幕脸色一变，伤势这么严重，如果不是赵宇有武道修为在身，恐怕这种伤势早就已经咽气了。
原本宁静的晋武侯府开始嘈杂起来，各种奴仆丫鬟奔走。
有人快速的前往东城去请玄机医馆最好的大夫。
“我的儿啊！”
赵宇的亲母，晋武侯夫人匆忙的跑进了房间中，看到了躺在床榻上，不省人事的儿子。
“这是谁做的，下手竟然如此狠毒，一点都不将我晋武侯府放在眼里！”
content_en:
In the military tent!
Xia Chen looked at Qian Nan and said nothing for a long time. Cold sweat broke out on Qian Nan's forehead.
Just when Qian Nan was frightened, a calm voice came to his ears.
"Get up!"
"Thank you, sir!"
Qian Nan felt relieved and felt that the oppression that enveloped him had disappeared. In just a short moment, he felt like his days were like years.
He felt that the power of this new captain was much more terrifying than that of the lieutenant general in the army.
"Is this the direct descendant from the Zhendong Hou Mansion? This demeanor is truly extraordinary!"
Qian Nan sighed inwardly.
"How about patrolling the streets?"
"Everything is fine. We encountered a theft incident on the way and have already arrested the thief and sent him to the prison of the Criminal Department!"
Qian Nan quickly responded respectfully.
Xia Chen asked some more questions, mainly about the scope of work of Habayashi Wei and some precautions. Of course, he already knew most of them, and he was asking about some details.
"There has been some unrest in the capital recently. Daqing's spies have begun to appear. Our Yulin Guards have been ordered to assist the Lantern Bearer in finding these spies as soon as possible!"
Qian Nan mentioned another thing that caught Xia Chen's attention.
The Lantern Bearer is the name of an organization. It was a special situation in the Great Wu Dynasty. It was not affiliated with the cabinet or the six ministries. It was an organization that was independent of the civil and military military system and was only responsible to the emperor.
It's a bit similar to the Jin Yiwei of the Ming Dynasty in Xia Chen's memory.
Xia Chen nodded thoughtfully and did not continue to ask any more questions.
Although the Forbidden Army is powerful, it is not a period of war. In fact, the Forbidden Army is not as powerful as imagined in the capital.
At least, once there are some cases or enemy spies, the first thing the emperor thinks of is the Lantern Man, followed by the Ministry of Punishment, Dali Temple, etc. Most of them, the Yulin Guards, just assist, or when the dust is finally settled, they help arrest people and ransack their homes.
……
noon!
Xia Chen invited his colleagues and subordinates to have dinner at Tongfu Tower in the capital, and all his colleagues were very considerate.
As long as they were in the army and had no mission, they all came to Tongfu Tower.
In the end, even Li Wenzhong and Qin Mu arrived at the scene, which made Xia Chen's colleagues feel awe-struck. Everyone in the capital was a human being, and they knew very well what this scene represented.
Therefore, he treated Xia Chen with increasing respect, and frequently and enthusiastically offered toasts.
Just when Xia Chen was enjoying the spring breeze, the Jin Wuhou Mansion in the capital had already exploded.
"Master, Master, what's going on!"
In front of an extraordinary gate, the guard saw Zhao Yu being brought back by his soldiers from afar.
At this time, Zhao Yu looked extremely miserable. Not only were his arms drooping, but his entire back was covered in blood and flesh. He had already passed out and was unconscious.
The guard who rushed over changed his face when he saw this scene. The injury was so serious. If Zhao Yu hadn't had martial arts cultivation, he might have died from this injury long ago.
The originally peaceful Jin Wuhou Mansion began to become noisy, with all kinds of servants and maids running around.
Someone quickly went to Dongcheng to ask for the best doctor at Xuanji Medical Center.
"My son!"
Zhao Yu's biological mother, Mrs. Jin Wuhou, hurriedly ran into the room and saw her son lying on the bed, unconscious.
"Who did this? He was so vicious and didn't take my Jin Wuhou Mansion seriously at all!"
